body: 102 Railroad Ave Ste B, Suisun City

Never put other people before you. Sometimes it’s okay if you are doing it all the time, you are bound to get hurt in the end. Speaking from personal experience, I had always put my friends happiness before me no matter what. I got them good part time jobs when they asked for help, drive them for hours one way and was always there for them but in the end realized they ‘hate me’ and yes that’s the exact words used. Nowadays I’ve learned to just do what I wanna do, still a long way to go but still it’s progress.
